description: This file contains the implementation of the ReturnReason model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages CRUD operations, caching, and data retrieval related to product return reasons in the admin localisation context.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Model class handling return reason data operations, including add, edit, delete, retrieve, and associated descriptions in multiple languages, with caching support.

methods.name: addReturnReason
methods.description: Creates a new return reason record in the database and adds descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editReturnReason
methods.description: Updates an existing return reason by deleting the old and adding new descriptions.

methods.name: deleteReturnReason
methods.description: Removes a return reason record from the database.

methods.name: deleteReturnReasonsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return reason descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getReturnReason
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return reason record based on its ID.

methods.name: getReturnReasons
methods.description: Fetches a list of return reasons, with optional filters, sorting, pagination, and caching.

methods.name: getTotalReturnReasons
methods.description: Returns the total count of return reason records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a return reason in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions linked to a particular language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific description of a return reason in a particular language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all descriptions for a return reason across different languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all return reason descriptions for a specific language.
